Media personality and entrepreneur, Destiny Ezeyim, popularly known as Radiogad, has continued to expand his business interests across real estate, entertainment, agriculture, automobile dealerships, and other sectors.
In a statement shared with Saturday Beats, the British-Nigerian, who is from Anambra State, stated that he has diversified beyond broadcasting into several ventures, including movie production, brand endorsements, event promotion and media.
The statement added, “He is the founder of Gadnation Records and president of the Gadnation Movement, a social media and community initiative through which he engages with his audience and supports various causes.
“Radiogad’s business interests reportedly include residential and commercial property investments in several Nigerian locations, including Lagos, Abuja, Anambra, Enugu, Owerri, Port Harcourt, Calabar, Jos, Kano and Ebonyi State. He is also said to have property interests in the United Kingdom, other parts of Europe and the United States.
“In the entertainment sector, his activities span music, film production and event promotion, while his other ventures include agriculture, automobile sales and brand partnerships.”
It added that beyond his commercial interests, Radiogad is involved in philanthropic activities aimed at supporting underprivileged members of society through various community initiatives.
Tofarati Ige, the Lifestyle Editor, has over 10 years experience in entertainment and lifestyle journalism. He is a music, film, arts and fashion critic. An author of two books, he also has interests in poetry and spoken word..
